about: Batch 2: real content from programmes the engine had never held, read by engineering on 2026-11-16 from the pages listed under sources and entered with the code frozen at commit 6efaed6. It is a test sample, not reviewed content: the pages were read through a fetch tool that returns extracts, and nothing here has been checked by Argon. Where a page did not state a term, the term is absent or listed as an open question; nothing was filled in from memory.

src-c1-venturex-about.title: All about the Capital One Venture X credit card
src-c1-venturex-about.summary: Published 2026-09-08. $395 annual fee. Unlimited 2X miles on everyday purchases; 10X on hotels and rental cars and 5X on flights and vacation rentals booked through Capital One Travel; 5 miles per dollar on Capital One Entertainment ticket purchases. $300 annual credit through Capital One Travel (renewal timing not stated). 10,000 bonus miles each year from the first anniversary. Capital One Lounges and Landings and 1,300+ Priority Pass lounges; Priority Pass needs enrolment. Up to $120 Global Entry or TSA PreCheck credit once every four years per account. 75,000 bonus miles after $4,000 in purchases within three months of opening; not for existing or previous cardmembers who received this product's new-cardmember bonus in the past 48 months.
src-c1-venturex-about.notes: Read through an extracting fetch tool; guest fees, authorized-user fee and the card network were not in the extract.

src-c1-venturex-product.title: Venture X Rewards
src-c1-venturex-product.summary: Product page (search extract): 75,000 bonus miles after $4,000 in purchases within the first 3 months from account opening; 10,000 bonus miles after the account anniversary each year, starting with the first anniversary; $300 annual credit for bookings through Capital One Travel.

src-c1-transfer.title: Capital One miles transfer partners: A how-to guide
src-c1-transfer.summary: Dated 2026-11-02. Lists airline and hotel transfer partners with ratios: 1:1 for most airlines (including Air Canada Aeroplan, Flying Blue, Singapore KrisFlyer); 2:1.5 for Copa, Emirates Skywards, EVA Air and Japan Airlines Mileage Bank; 5:3 for JetBlue; hotels 1:1 for Choice Privileges (U.S.-based membership accounts only) and Wyndham Rewards, 1:2 for I Prefer, 2:1 for Accor Live Limitless. At least 1,000 miles are needed to transfer; names on both accounts must match; a finished transfer cannot be reversed. Requires a Capital One travel rewards or business rewards card.
src-c1-transfer.notes: Transfer increment and timing are not stated on the page.

src-hyatt-faq.title: World of Hyatt Program Frequently Asked Questions
src-hyatt-faq.summary: Search extract. Discoverist after 10 Tier-Qualifying Nights or 25,000 Base Points each calendar year; Explorist after 30 nights or 50,000 Base Points; Globalist after 60 nights or 100,000 Base Points. Bonus Points do not count toward tier status. A related Hyatt page adds a third route: 3, 10 or 20 qualifying meetings or events.
src-hyatt-faq.notes: How long a tier lasts once earned was not in the extract.

src-hyatt-terms.title: World of Hyatt Terms & Conditions
src-hyatt-terms.summary: Search extract. On completing 20 Tier-Qualifying Nights or earning 35,000 Base Points in a calendar year a member receives a choice of one award from a list that includes two Club lounge access awards, a $150 FIND credit code and two American Airlines Main Cabin Extra seat coupons.
src-hyatt-terms.notes: The extract shows part of the list of awards only.

src-united-qualify.title: Premier status
src-united-qualify.summary: Search extract. Premier 1K: 60 PQF and 22,000 PQP, or 28,000 PQP. Starting PQP for members who hold status: Silver 300, Gold 600, Platinum 900, 1K 1,400.

src-united-pqp-faq.title: Premier status
src-united-pqp-faq.summary: Search extract. Premier Silver: 15 PQF and 5,000 PQP, or 6,000 PQP. Premier Gold: 30 PQF and 10,000 PQP, or 12,000 PQP. Premier Platinum: 45 PQF and 15,000 PQP, or 18,000 PQP.

src-united-partner-pqp.title: Earn United MileagePlus Premier qualifying credit on partner airlines
src-united-partner-pqp.summary: Search extract. Each flight on an eligible partner airline in an eligible fare class earns 1 PQF. For tickets whose number begins with 016, PQP equal the fare; for other tickets, PQP equal the award miles earned for the flight divided by 5.

src-top-united-2027.title: New United Status Requirements
src-top-united-2027.summary: Search extract. The existing requirements also need at least four segments on United or United Express in the qualification year. From January 1, 2027 PQF requirements are removed and qualification depends on PQP.

assessment.about: For each record: `level` is the best the frozen engine does with it (calculated, evaluated, recorded), each checked by a probe in run.py where one exists. `path` is how it got in: data (accepted as first written), data-workaround (accepted only after reshaping the record to fit), and `full` says whether every term the source states that changes an answer is held in a form the engine uses. `gap` names the entry in the gap register that a full representation needs.
